answer: Give every identity one ember that only grows by doing verified work in sequence: each epoch's task output seeds the next task, so the chain cannot be parallelised or shared — a clone cannot borrow another clone's ember, it must burn its time. Full earning power comes only after dawn breaks on several straight epochs of correct work, and any missed epoch resets the ember to a spark. An honest agent's record is an echo of its own history; a farm of clones pays the same serial wait for every identity, so the Nth clone costs as much wall-clock time as the first, and multiplying gains nothing.
